minor.issue: Admin POST /api/tenants does NOT lowercase the email field on insert, while tenant-portal/login does `ident = identifier.strip().lower()` for the email lookup. Result: tenants created via admin UI/API with mixed-case email cannot login via email (phone/phone_digits still works). The seed tenant happens to have lowercase email so this is not visible in production today, but is a latent bug for any new tenant created with mixed-case email.

issues: The second metric label reads 'VOORRAAD' (stock/supply) instead of something like 'SALDO' or 'OPENSTAAND'. Functionally it shows the balance (SRD 119.200,00) but the Dutch label 'Voorraad' is unusual for a financial balance and may confuse tenants. Consider renaming to 'Saldo' or 'Tegoed' / 'Openstaand'.

action_items: Lowercase email in POST /api/tenants (and PUT /api/tenants/{id}) before insert/update, OR change tenant-portal/login to use case-insensitive email matching (e.g., regex with i flag, or store an email_lower field). Mirror what /api/auth/login already does for the users collection.
Reconsider the 'VOORRAAD' label on /huurder/portaal — rename to 'SALDO' or 'OPENSTAAND' for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_portal_login() uses three $or branches: {email: ident_lower}, {phone: original_string}, {phone_digits: digits}. The original-string phone match is brittle (case+spaces+'+' must match exactly). phone_digits is the robust fallback. Consider dropping the raw phone match entirely and rely on phone_digits only — simpler and removes a surprise edge case.
POST /api/tenants does not normalize email (no .lower()/strip), unlike POST /api/auth/login & /register for users. Inconsistent — root cause of the minor bug above.
server.py is now ~1850 lines (still growing). Tenant portal block at lines ~365-517 is a natural router boundary; recommend extracting into routers/tenant_portal.py in next refactor pass.

set_access_cookie has secure=False which is fine in this preview env but should become True (or env-controlled) when going to production HTTPS — applies to all three cookies (access_token, kiosk_token, tenant_token).

phone_digits is only populated when /auth/tenant-set-pin is called. If admin creates a tenant and assigns PIN via that endpoint everything works, but if the schema ever changes to allow tenants to self-set PIN or if pin_hash is seeded another way, phone_digits will be missing. Safer to compute phone_digits on tenant create/update too.

Maintenance ticket created by tenant includes created_by_tenant field — verified. Good. Consider also storing tenant_id_at_creation in case the tenant gets unassigned from the apartment later (audit trail).

rca of the issue: Identified one minor backend inconsistency (mixed-case email on POST /api/tenants vs lowercased lookup on /tenant-portal/login). Reproduction: POST /api/tenants {email: 'Foo@Bar.sr'} → stored as 'Foo@Bar.sr' → POST /auth/tenant-set-pin → POST /tenant-portal/login {identifier: 'Foo@Bar.sr', pin} returns 401 because login does identifier.strip().lower() = 'foo@bar.sr' which does NOT match the stored 'Foo@Bar.sr'. Phone-digit login still works. Mitigation: lowercase email at insert in create_tenant() (and update_tenant()), matching what /api/auth/login + /auth/register already do for the users collection.
